title_template: The Drowned Abbess Laid to Rest
body_template: In the deepest vault of the Sunken Crypt, {hero_a} and {hero_b} broke the iron anchors, turned the ancient sluice, and silenced the Drowned Abbess. The black waters receded, and another piece of Hearthvale's memory was written back into the Chronicle.
The massive bronze bell of the Sunken Crypt rang with a deafening shudder as {hero_a} slammed the Bellkeeper into its own chime, giving {hero_b} the opening to break its vigil once and for all.
Emberrest's long-cold anvil rang with striking iron once more. {hero_a} and {hero_b} rekindled the furnace coals, unlocking the craft of runes and the reshaping of steel.
The stone ovens of the old kitchen were cleared of ash. With fresh herbs and mountain salt, {hero_a} and {hero_b} shared their first warm meal before setting out into the faded roads.
At the hearthside, {giver} offered {item_name} to {receiver}. A quiet smile, a grateful nod, and a promise that every expedition carries both of them through together.
When {downed_hero} fell beneath the crushing tide, {rescuer} held the line against all odds, shielding them from harm and pulling them back to their feet. 'I'm holding you to dinner for that one.'

Standing before the ruins of Emberrest, {hero_a} and {hero_b} stood in agreement: the {choice_name} would be restored first. Not by command or contest, but because two minds weighed the hearth and saw the same future.
With a flash of pure intuition, {hero} attempted the improbable—and the dice came up twenty. The gate groaned open cleanly without a single alarm raised, earning a rare verse in the Chronicle.
The attempt began with immense confidence and ended with a dropped lantern and soot across {hero}'s face. {partner} could only chuckle and offer a helping hand: 'Next time, let's try the handle.'

The air froze into singing crystal as frost met crushing steel. For the first time, {hero_a}'s primer and {hero_b}'s finisher detonated in full Resonance, proving the old verses true: two halves make one complete fight.

When danger pressed hardest, the light between them answered. With a shared confirmation, {hero_a} and {hero_b} unleashed the Hearthflare, a radiant barrier and crushing strike born of the bond between them.
When last the Chronicle was opened, {hero_a} and {hero_b} {last_achievement}. Now the ink dries and the next road calls.
